name: moofmail
description: Private iCloud Mail, Calendar and Contacts for Claude. Runs on your own computer, reads without marking mail read, and never sends to a new recipient without your approval.

apple_id.title: Apple Account email
apple_id.description: Your iCloud address, for example you@icloud.com, you@me.com or you@mac.com.

app_password.title: App-specific password
app_password.description: Generate one at account.apple.com > Sign-In and Security > App-Specific Passwords. It looks like abcd-efgh-ijkl-mnop. This is NOT your Apple Account password.

send_enabled.title: Allow sending email
send_enabled.description: Off by default. When on, the first message to any new recipient (To or Cc) still needs your explicit approval in the conversation.

apple_id_2.title: Second Apple Account email (optional)
apple_id_2.description: Leave blank unless you also want a second iCloud account.

app_password_2.title: App-specific password for the second account (optional)
app_password_2.description: A separate app-specific password, generated while signed in as the second account.
